name: MUON

source_note: Checked against getmuon.com (home, product workspace and superagent pages, docs overview and CLI reference, integrations, FAQ, pricing, download), the GitHub repo (README, languages, releases, apps/desktop/package.json) and the installer feed at download.getmuon.com (v0.7.19, 2026-10-16).
